title: Could Sam Ehlinger push for the Broncos backup quarterback job?

sources.title: Could Sam Ehlinger push for the Broncos backup quarterback job?
sources.description: After a standout college career at Texas, quarterback Sam Ehlinger was selected in the 6th round of the 2021 NFL Draft by the Indianapolis Colts.
